name: Baseline Framework Policy
description: Three baselines required for all research

baseline_a_null.name: Null / Random Prediction
baseline_a_null.purpose: Evaluate whether predictive metrics exceed chance

baseline_c_simple.name: Simple Existing Model
baseline_c_simple.required_for: All hypotheses claiming improvement over existing methods

rules: Baseline selection must be declared before confirmatory execution
Baseline results must be frozen before hypothesis testing
No baseline substitution after seeing hypothesis results
